title: QDTraj: Exploration of Diverse Trajectory Primitives for Articulated Objects Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2604.22551v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Thanks to the latest advances in learning and robotics, domestic robots are beginning to enter homes, aiming to execute household chores autonomously. However, robots still struggle to perform autonomous manipulation tasks in open-ended environments. In this context, this paper presents a method that enables a robot to manipulate a wide spectrum of articulated objects.   In this paper, we automatically generate different robot low-level trajectory primitives to manipulate given object articulations. A very important point when it comes to generating expert trajectories is to consider the diversity of solutions to achieve the same goal. Indeed, knowing diverse low-level primitives to accomplish the same task enables the robot to choose the optimal solution in its real-world environment, with live constraints and unexpected changes. translated_title: QDTraj：面向铰接物体机器人操作的多样化轨迹基元探索
translated_abstract: 得益于学习和机器人技术的最新进展，家用机器人开始进入家庭，旨在自主执行家务劳动。然而，机器人在开放式环境中执行自主操作任务时仍然面临困难。在此背景下，本文提出了一种使机器人能够操作广泛铰接物体的方法。在本文中，我们自动生成不同的机器人低层轨迹基元来操作给定的物体关节。在生成专家轨迹时，一个非常重要的考虑因素是实现同一目标的解决方案的多样性。事实上，掌握多种可完成同一任务的低层基元，使机器人能够在具有实时约束和意外变化的真实世界环境中选择最优解决方案。为此，我们提出了一种基于质量-多样性算法的方法，该方法利用稀疏奖励……
tldr: 本文提出基于质量-多样性（Quality-Diversity）算法的QDTraj方法，自动生成多样化的低层轨迹基元，使机器人能够灵活操作各种铰接物体，并在存在实时约束与突发变化的真实环境中自主选择最优操作方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes QDTraj, a Quality-Diversity-based method that automatically generates diverse low-level trajectory primitives, enabling robots to manipulate a wide range of articulated objects and autonomously select optimal manipulation solutions in real-world environments with live constraints and unexpected changes.
